Study format
Self-paced and instructor-led options; enrollment windows, identity and citizenship conditions vary by offering.
Pricing
Some DHS/FEMA-funded cybersecurity training is no-cost; other training is paid. Free access does not establish a current transferable award.
Assessments
Course-specific content and post-tests apply. Check current examination, badge and transcript requirements; universal proctoring details were not established.
